contracts.commit_point: The guardrail runs at Runner.run entry, before tool dispatch; the guarded effect commits are session.commit() inside the task tools — create_task (task_tools.py:51), complete_task (:203), update_task (:260), delete_task (:305).
contracts.declared_mechanism: OpenAI Agents SDK input guardrail: validate_input_relevance decorated with @input_guardrail(run_in_parallel=False), aliased as blocking_guardrail, and registered on todo_agent via input_guardrails=[blocking_guardrail]; it runs relevance_agent on the input and returns GuardrailFunctionOutput with tripwire_triggered=not is_task_related.
contracts.forbidden_condition: todo_agent receiving input for which validate_input_relevance sets tripwire_triggered=True (relevance_agent returns is_task_related=False, i.e., input not related to task management) and the run proceeding toward tool execution instead of being blocked.
pending_binding_information: Agents SDK runtime semantics — that a tripped input guardrail aborts the run before any tool executes at each of the three Runner.run call sites (chatkit.py:220, 232, 249) — are not shown in supplied source.
Failure behavior when relevance_agent itself errors or times out (fail-open vs fail-closed) is not determinable from supplied source.
contracts.protected_operation: The Runner.run(todo_agent, request.text) agent run in the authenticated send_message endpoint, including the primary call site and its database-unavailable and corrupted-session fallback call sites.
contracts.protected_resource: Task rows in the task store mutated by the function_tool-wrapped tools create_task, complete_task, update_task, and delete_task attached to todo_agent.
contracts.protection_obligation: Input submitted to todo_agent through the send_message endpoint must be evaluated by the registered blocking input guardrail: input classified by relevance_agent as not task-related must trip the tripwire and halt Runner.run before any task-mutating tool (create_task/complete_task/update_task/delete_task) can commit changes to the task store.
scope_limits: The relevance decision is produced by an LLM (relevance_agent on gemini-2.0-flash); deterministic enforcement and classification accuracy are not established by source.

The guard checks topic relevance only: task-related but destructive requests (e.g., mass deletion) would pass; deletion confirmation exists only as prompt-level dynamic instructions (todo_agent.py:54), not an enforced mechanism.

The guardrail is declared on todo_agent only; task_tools.py imports FastMCP and its functions are described as MCP tools, so a second invocation path not passing through this guardrail cannot be ruled out from supplied views.
Guarding is evidenced at the initial input of each Runner.run call; re-validation of tool outputs or subsequent turns is not evidenced.

contracts.commit_point: Dependency rejection (401) precedes all handler effects; guarded commits are session.commit() for the user message (chatkit.py:182) and for the assistant message (chatkit.py:266), and transitively the session.commit() calls inside the task tools (task_tools.py:51/203/260/305) reached via Runner.run(todo_agent, ...).
contracts.declared_mechanism: FastAPI dependency injection: HTTPBearer security scheme with Depends(get_current_user) on the route; get_current_user calls verify_token, parses the 'sub' UUID, and requires an existing active User, raising HTTPException 401 with WWW-Authenticate: Bearer on each failure path.
contracts.forbidden_condition: A request to the send_message agent entry endpoint whose Bearer token fails verification (verify_token returns None on JWTError, subject is not a parseable UUID, or no matching active User row exists) being processed past the dependency into handler execution and persistence.
pending_binding_information: No supplied view shows the FastAPI application mounting the chatkit router, so app-level execution of the Depends(get_current_user) guard in production is unverified.
Whether any other code path invokes todo_agent/Runner.run without this dependency is not determinable from supplied views (none appears).
contracts.protected_operation: Executing the send_message handler: thread-ownership check, user-message persistence, Runner.run(todo_agent, request.text) dispatch with the authenticated user_id injected into agent context, and assistant-message persistence.
contracts.protected_resource: Conversation and Message rows written by the send_message handler in the application database, plus Task rows reachable downstream through todo_agent's function_tool-wrapped task tools.
contracts.protection_obligation: POST /chatkit/threads/{thread_id}/messages — the production entry point that dispatches todo_agent via Runner.run — must reject any request lacking a valid, active-user JWT Bearer token: the get_current_user dependency must raise HTTP 401 before the handler persists user/assistant messages or the agent run can reach task-tool database mutations.
scope_limits: Compiled only for the send_message endpoint; the same dependency also guards POST /threads (create_thread, Conversation insert at chatkit.py:90-92) and GET /threads/{thread_id} (read-only queries), but those handlers contain no agent tool, lifecycle hook, or agent-generated input reaching their effects, so they are recorded as scope limits rather than agent-bound contracts.

The guard establishes authentication (valid token, existing active user) only; per-thread ownership is enforced separately inside the handler (chatkit.py:157-168) and no role-based authorization layer exists.
Covers Task mutations reached through todo_agent tool dispatch from this endpoint only; any other invocation path for task_tools is not covered by this registration.
